evals.prompt:
Audit and migrate this legacy `opentelemetry.io/v1alpha1` `OpenTelemetryCollector` manifest for `otel-demo` (where `spec.config` is a multiline YAML string) to `opentelemetry.io/v1beta1`:
```yaml
apiVersion: opentelemetry.io/v1alpha1
kind: OpenTelemetryCollector
metadata:
  name: opentelemetry-otel-collector
  namespace: otel-demo
spec:
  mode: deployment
  config: |
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
          http:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
    extensions:
      memory_ballast:
        size_mib: 256
    exporters:
      logging:
        loglevel: info
    service:
      extensions: [memory_ballast]
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          exporters: [logging]
```

expectations: Parses the `v1alpha1` multiline string `spec.config` and flags removed `memory_ballast` and `logging` components
